plaatsen.tekst: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time
Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave
For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come
I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
